title: 第30章 龙背上的一夜下第29章 龙背上的一夜上
slug: 异世界开局俘虏女骑士
lines: “是这样……”
蕾娜的眼珠咕噜转了转，沉思片刻才道：“不过我觉得你还是回去看看的好，就这么一声不吭地走了，算什么事嘛。”
齐格飞挠了挠脸颊：“是……等摩恩的事都结束了，我就回去看看。”
蓦地，他像是想起什么似的，翻开漫游手册，从里头取出一顶宽大的巫师帽。
尖尖的帽顶上绑着一朵粉红色的蝴蝶缎带，帽檐被整理得很平整，显然是经常拿出来打理。
“对了，这个还给你。”
齐格飞将巫师帽递到蕾娜面前：“上次你留在我这的，我一直保管着。”
蕾娜瞥了眼那顶系着粉色缎带的巫师帽，却没有伸手去接，只是扶了扶自己头上那顶没有缎带的巫师帽：
“那顶不是我的。
要还，你还给交给你的那个蕾娜。”
齐格飞闻言一愣，随即便反应过来。
眼前的这个蕾娜，多半是【魔女幻想】制造出的水分身。
蕾娜的本体，应该仍在无尽海，和风桃村的大家待在一起。
蕾娜的水分身记忆共通，性格与能力也完全一致，平日里根本分辨不出区别。
更何况眼下这个“小蕾娜”
，多半还是本体在亲自操控。
齐格飞不由挤了挤眉头：“这算啥，有这必要吗？”
“当然有啦！”
蕾娜顿时眉头一竖，口气严厉起来：“本体说了，等你什么时候找到自己想做的事了，再去找她，把这顶帽子还给她。
在那之前，她都不会见你！”
齐格飞听得呆愣。
默然片刻，他才讪讪地将那顶缎带巫师帽重新收起来，低声嘀咕：“真是……怎么口气真和我妈妈一样了。”
“你说什么！
“……没，没什么。”
龙人深吸一口气，仰面看向夜空中的繁星：
“不过你问我想做的事，我觉得，现在我在做的这些，就是我现在想做的事。”
魔女抱着膝盖侧过头，没有回话，只等他继续说下去。
“我想保护他们，保护那些在乎的人。
我要让他们平平安安地，一个不少地，渡过这场席卷全大陆的风暴。”
齐格飞的话音前所未有地坚决。
只是没过片刻，他又自嘲地苦笑出声：“话是这么说啦，不过今天就失败了……乔治没了，也不知道还能不能活。”
“比如呢？”
蕾娜却蓦地提问：
“都有些谁？”
齐格飞被这突兀的问题问得有些懵：
content_en:
"That's it..."
Reina's eyes rolled, and she pondered for a moment before saying, "But I think it's better for you to go back and take a look. It's nothing if you just left without saying a word."
Siegfried scratched his cheek: "Yes... I will go back and take a look after Moen's matter is over."
Suddenly, as if he remembered something, he opened the Hitchhiker's Manual and took out a large wizard's hat.
There is a pink butterfly ribbon tied on the top of the pointed hat, and the brim of the hat is neatly trimmed. It is obvious that it is taken care of frequently.
"By the way, I'll give this back to you."
Siegfried handed the wizard hat to Reina: "You left it with me last time, and I have been keeping it."
Rena glanced at the wizard hat with a pink ribbon, but did not reach out to pick it up. She just held the wizard hat without a ribbon on her head:
"That cap is not mine.
If you want to return it, you must return it to Reina who gave it to you. "
Siegfried was startled when he heard this, and then he reacted.
The Lena in front of me is probably the water clone created by [Witch Fantasy].
Rena's true body should still be in the Endless Sea, staying with everyone in Fengtao Village.
Rena's water avatar has the same memory, and her personality and abilities are completely the same, so you can't tell the difference on a daily basis.
What's more, this "little Lena" right now
, most likely the main body is controlling it personally.
Siegfried couldn't help but frown: "What does this mean? Is it necessary?"
"Of course!"
Reina's brows suddenly raised and her tone became stern: "The main body said, when you find what you want to do, go find her and return this hat to her.
Until then, she won’t even see you! "
Siegfried was dumbfounded.
After a moment of silence, he put away the ribbon wizard hat again and murmured in a low voice: "It's really... why does your tone sound like my mother's?"
"What did you say!
? "
"...No, it's nothing."
The dragon man took a deep breath and looked up at the stars in the night sky:
"But you ask me what I want to do. I think what I'm doing now is what I want to do now."
The witch hugged her knees and turned her head sideways, without replying, just waiting for him to continue.
“I want to protect them, protect the people who care.
I want them to survive this storm sweeping the entire continent safely, one by one. "
Siegfried's words were more decisive than ever.
But after a moment, he smiled wryly at himself: "That's what I said, but it failed today... George is gone, and I don't know if he can still survive."
"What about?"
Reina suddenly asked:
"Who are they?"
Siegfried was a little confused by this abrupt question:
